original_test_intent: Run the approved application-level workload across the required NVIDIA GPU/NVSwitch fabric and verify quantitative end-to-end performance plus complete fabric/compute health and post-test usability.
original_method: Pin harness/app/config/data and stable GPU/NVSwitch/port topology; define selected devices, workload scale, placement, warmup, duration/repetitions, output metrics/units/statistics/thresholds and SKU exception; preserve baseline and drain jobs; run under target-complete utilization, power/thermal/error watchdog; retain raw results and compare; stop all processes and revalidate fabric/GPU/host health.
manual_activity: Application/fabric owner supplies pinned workload/config/data, complete target topology and numerical oracle, approves the long workload/recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Stable complete GPU/NVSwitch/port topology and device placement
Workload scale, warmup, duration/repetitions and coverage oracle
Metric units/statistic/numeric thresholds, SKU exception and usability checks
Dedicated job drain, telemetry, watchdog, OOB and recovery
safety_requirements: No floating harness or generic benchmark substitution
Verify target-complete device/path selection before run
Abort on limit, link degradation, XID/reset, workload or management anomaly
Stop all processes, preserve first failure and never clear or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Run approved application once per required configuration
Compute metrics and coverage with raw evidence
Cleanup/recover and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve SKU exception and post-usability oracle
Disposition performance/health anomalies and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only pinned vendor `nvlink_appperf` with approved application/config/data and explicit stable device placement; preserve complete unfiltered output and all child-process argv.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Application-performance purpose and ten/twenty-minute estimates remain; approved workload controls actual timing.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce workload-level results plus per-device/path utilization, performance and health coverage, correlated with power/thermal/throttle and error evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns vendor pass into a reproducible end-to-end application measurement with complete fabric coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Raw NVLink transport bandwidth does not prove application scaling, computation or memory behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Application performance depends on workload/data placement and software stack; thresholds are not portable across configurations without explicit normalization.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner defines workload and scaling topology; partial fabric configurations need separate expected values and explicit coverage status.
expected_evidence: Stable full fabric topology, device placement and target coverage map
Exact argv, workload scale/warmup/duration/repetitions and raw results
Post-fabric/SUT usability, exception/disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently names NVLink application-performance FCT; workload and numeric criteria are absent prerequisites rather than conflicting branches.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Harness/application/topology/oracle are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds reproducible workload identity, complete target coverage and quantitative end-to-end performance/health evidence to the generic FCT result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Application performance combines compute, memory, communication and placement; high NVLink bandwidth alone does not guarantee correct scaling. A workload may pass while using only one GPU or bypassing intended links, so per-device/path utilization and stable placement are required. Raw runs and an approved statistic prevent selective reporting, while telemetry and error deltas reveal throttling or recovered faults hidden by a top-level pass.
